items.title: Coverage (completeness wave, 2026-10-15): Runway's in-context video editing model (May 21, 2026) added, and the Gen-4.5 record corrected in the same wave: Runway did ship a new model in 2026, in the editing lane. No Gen-5 exists.

items.title: Coverage (completeness coordinator addendum, 2026-10-15): Runway performance-capture record added. Runway Dev's first-party line is Gen-4.5, Aleph 2.0 and Act-Two; the completeness wave's lanes carried the first two. Act-Two transfers a driving performance (face, head, hands, body) onto a character image or video, up to 30 s at 24 fps, billed at 5 credits per second.

items.title: Coverage (completeness wave, 2026-10-15): Google image record added. The guide tracked no Google image model while its keyframe chapters assumed one; the record covers Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, Feb 2026) and Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image, Nov 2025) with the family lineage, and leaves the single-source '2.1' report unrecorded as unverified.
items.label: Verified

items.title: Flag dismissed + calibration (Watchtower 2.13): run 1 flagged Wan 3.0 on the Zacks stock-news article for the second consecutive pass (9756a800…, 15,877 chars in 2.12 → 38edd398…, 15,897 chars in this pass's run 1; two checker-path probes returned the flagged signature exactly). Read in full it is the same 25 August 2026 equity story, Alibaba's Wan 3.0 debut following the $10.2B share sale, whose Wan content is the launch coverage already behind the record. The page's chrome rotates between days while staying stable within one, so the URL is signature-excluded for this model in the 2.13 calibration (still fetched and recorded every run), following the 2.12 magichour precedent. No record change.
items.label: Verified

items.title: Flag dismissed (Watchtower 2.12): the adjudication run flagged Wan 3.0 on its Zacks stock-news source (Alibaba's Wan 3.0 debut / $10.2B share sale, 25 August 2026). Two checker-path adjudication fetches returned the flagged signature exactly (9756a800…, 15,877 chars, +30 on the 15,847-char baseline, page chrome on an equity story), and the article's Wan content is the launch coverage already behind the record; no spec, rate, or status fact on it moves the record. items.title: Flag dismissed (Watchtower 2.13): run 1 flagged Wan 2.7 on createvision.ai's model page (4d5b9447…, 68,640 chars → 985bfeab…, 67,855). Two checker-path probes returned the flagged signature exactly. The page's credit table (40 credits/s at 720p) is CreateVision's own reseller-pool pricing, not a Wan rate the record rests on, and its Wan 2.7 facts, 2 to 15s clips, native audio, per-second billing, match the record. Dismissed as reseller-page churn.
items.label: Verified

items.title: Flag dismissed (Watchtower 2.17): run 3 flagged Vidu S2 on lapaasvoice.com's S2 explainer (7d9bf2d6…, 7,636 chars → 2d5c1921…, 7,655). Two checker-path probes returned the flagged signature exactly; read in full, the post matches the record on every carried point (S2-Avatar for continuous interactive characters, real-time output raised from 540p to 720p; S2-Editing applying style, clothing, character, and background references to a live stream) and publishes no price or version fact that postdates or contradicts the record; Vidu's official pricing page held its baseline signature (66450841…) in the same run. The +19 chars are blog churn. (The page's pass-2 appearance was a baseline-settling artifact, not a counted churn flag; this in-pass move is its first counted flag, no exclusion; a second earns one.) Dismissed as explainer churn.
items.label: Verified

items.title: Flag dismissed + calibration (Watchtower 2.15): run 2 flagged Veo 3.1 on scriptbyai.com's multi-vendor pricing page (→ da1fa4dd…, 45,040 chars), the page adjudicated in 2.13, whose Veo table carries Google's long-standing published per-second rates and whose own changelog dates its last Veo change to 31 March 2026; the deltas sit in other vendors' tables. This pass the page additionally proved rendering-variant: six consecutive checker-path probes returned a smaller signature-stable rendering (4f242c2c…, 30,922 chars) while the checker runs received the full ~45k rendering. Veo's remaining sources all answered unchanged in the same run, and Google's own Gemini API pricing page was read verbatim in 2.14. This is the second flag on this URL for this model, so the 2.15 calibration signature-excludes it (exact URL) for Veo 3.1, still fetched and recorded every run; the rates stay signature-live on the model's remaining sources. Run 3, the final re-baseline, read changed=0 with the calibration live. No record change.
items.label: Verified

items.title: Flag dismissed (Watchtower 2.13): run 1 flagged Veo 3.1 on scriptbyai.com's multi-vendor pricing page (45717f00…, 46,273 chars → 7783188d…, 45,760).
